bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY AFTERNOON... Combined seas 18 to 22 ft with breakers, subsiding to 14 to 16 ft tonight, then to 10 to 12 ft on Monday morning. Bar conditions severe, becoming rough on Monday. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 345 PM Sunday, 400 AM Monday, and 415 PM Monday. The afternoon ebbs on Sunday and Monday will be strong.
